description:
Build a CSS linear or radial gradient string from color stops.

Returns: CSS gradient string (linear or radial).
Example input: {"type":"linear","angle":45,"stops":["#3b82f6","#8b5cf6"]}
On error, includes hint: `type` is 'linear' or 'radial'; provide at least 2 color `stops`.

angle.description: Angle in degrees for linear gradients (default 90). Ignored for radial.

stops.description: Color stops, e.g. ['#3B82F6', '#8B5CF6 50%', '#EC4899'] — hex, rgb(), hsl(), or named colors, with optional percentage.

name: css_gradient
title: CSS gradient builder
